articles.title: Hugo, da dupla com Guilherme, vai a jogo que garantiu acesso à Série C | G1
articles.standfirst: Cantor, que nasceu em Morrinhos, mas passou a infância em Goiatuba, acompanhou de perto a partida que garantiu o acesso do Azulão.
articles.summary: Cantor, que nasceu em Morrinhos, mas passou a infância em Goiatuba, acompanhou de perto a partida que garantiu o acesso do Azulão.
articles.body:
O cantor Hugo, da dupla com Guilherme, acompanhou de perto a partida que garantiu o acesso do Goiatuba à Série C do Campeonato Brasileiro de 2027. A presença do cantor começou mesmo antes do jogo rolar.

Hugo esteve próximo dos jogadores e acompanhou a preparação para o jogo, entrou no vestiário, no campo e gritou o gol da classificação da equipe. A relação com Goiatuba vem desde a infância.

O Goiatuba precisava apenas de um empate contra o São José para garantir a classificação. O jogo aconteceu no Estádio Divino Garcia Rosa e terminou em 1 a 1, com o Azulão conquistando o acesso.

A partida começou difícil para o time goiano que saiu perdendo ainda no primeiro tempo. O Goiatuba pressionou em busca do empate e conseguiu chegar ao gol aos 36 minutos da segunda etapa após um gol contra do atleta do São José.

Com o empate, o Goiatuba garantiu o acesso à Série C e iniciou a festa no estádio. Embora tenha nascido em Morrinhos, o cantor cresceu na cidade e mantém uma ligação afetiva com o município.

articles.body:
O Capital Inicial ensaiou na tarde desta quinta-feira (03) para o show do Rock in Rio. Ao som de "Independência", Dinho Ouro Preto falava com os funcionários que estavam na Cidade do Rock, no Rio de Janeiro, trabalhando no evento.

A banda vai se apresentar nesta sexta-feira (04) ao lado de Dado Villa-Lobos, no Palco Sunset. Outra atração do festival já está na cidade: a banda Hot Milk já chegou ao Brasil. Os músicos visitaram o Cristo Redentor e compartilharam as imagens em seu perfil no Instagram.

articles.title: Vicente Vallés reflexiona sobre la “pregunta” qué debería hacerse Pedro Sánchez tras el “ataque” a Ceuta: “No queremos hacer nada con Marruecos”
articles.standfirst: El presentador de ‘Antena 3 Noticias’ habla del presidente del Gobierno en ‘La Mesa’
articles.summary: El presentador de ‘Antena 3 Noticias’ habla del presidente del Gobierno en ‘La Mesa’
articles.body: Cristina Pardo ha estrenado este miércoles, 2 de septiembre, su nuevo formato en Antena 3. En ‘La Mesa’ se han reunido Iván Redondo, Carlos Alsina y Vicente Vallés. Este último ha reflexionado sobre la pregunta que debería hacerse Pedro Sánchez, especialmente tras sus declaraciones inmediatas tras la entrada irregular de migrantes a las fronteras de Ceuta. Por aquel entonces, el 31 de julio exactamente, el líder del PSOE afirmó que se había producido un “ataque a la integridad territorial de España”. Aunque Vallés comprende que “gobernar es muy difícil”, no entiende el giro radical que ha tomado parte del Ejecutivo alrededor de esta crisis. “Una parte especialmente difícil de gobernar es la parte diplomática y todavía más difícil es gestionar a Marruecos en esa parte diplomática. Eso es perfectamente comprensible”, apunta el presentador de ‘Antena 3 Noticias’, quien reconoce además que él mismo es “comprensivo” con la labor del presidente del Gobierno. Ahora bien, este cambio de paradigma se escapa de su control. Por eso, señala que Pedro Sánchez debería hacerse una pregunta: “¿Quién ha sido el atacante?”. Esta sería la cuestión principal que debería rondar la cabeza del líder del Ejecutivo, según Vallés, ya que “si ponemos el dedo en quién ha sido el atacante, el Gobierno tiene la responsabilidad de hacer algo con respecto a ese atacante”. No obstante, la impresión del periodista es completamente opuesta a lo que, a su juicio, debería hacer el Gobierno. “Como no queremos hacer nada con respecto a Marruecos, no queremos situar el dedo como atacante a Marruecos”, sentencia Vallés. Esta forma de explicar la situación ha sido muy compartida en redes sociales, con muchos usuarios mostrándose de acuerdo con las palabras del presentador de ‘Antena 3 Noticias’.

articles.title: Miley Cyrus Drops Last Name, Prompting Dad Billy Ray to Publicly Defend the Change: ‘Family Means More Than Ever Now’
articles.summary: Miley Cyrus has dropped her last name in the lead up to her tenth studio album, “Bass Persuades,” prompting her father, Billy Ray Cyrus, to speak out on X in...
articles.body:
Miley Cyrus has dropped her last name in the lead up to her tenth studio album, "Bass Persuades," prompting her father, Billy Ray Cyrus, to speak out on X in defense of the decision.

Miley's announcement fueled the rumor mill about alleged ongoing tensions between the pop star and her father (see The Daily Beast headline: "Pop Star Rebukes Dad With Plan to Change Her Famous Name"). But according to Billy Ray, Miley notified him about the name change in advance and he had nothing but support for his Grammy-winning daughter.

"Family means more than ever now," Billy Ray Cyrus wrote on X. "I always called my little girl Miley. Just … Miley. Just like I always called my little boy Braison. Bet you didn't know … I was just CYRUS before Achy Breaky Heart came out in 92…. I told Miley yesterday I felt good about her going with her first name. I mentioned Dolly and Cher. Thinking about it more and more … Elvis .. Prince … and so on. It's a natural progression for an iconic superstar legend. And the legend continues ! Looking forward to the new album."

Miley Cyrus announced Sept. 1 that her new album is titled "Bass Persuades" and will release on September 18 via Atlantic Records. The tracklist for the album includes 10 songs, plus features from Model/Actriz and Miike Snow's Andrew Wyatt. Cyrus will promote the album with a rare return to the stage courtesy of a two-night stint at the Hollywood Bowl in Los Angeles on Oct. 16 and 18.

"Music takes hold of us. We feel it, sing it, sometimes dance to it, let it out and carry on. It is powerful, vulnerable, sweet and strong," Miley wrote in announcing the album. "Heart full, heartache, every part of life in between. That's what the title means to me. Thank you for being a part of making my wildest dreams come true. I sincerely hope you love this album."

While rumors have persisted for years about tensions between Miley Cyrus and Billy Ray Cyrus, the duo reunited earlier this year on the "Hannah Montana" 20th anniversary special. Miley told People at the time that music is how the two have always stayed bonded, even amid family hardships.

"It's really the way we communicate," Miley said. "Whether it's sending a song we wrote in a text or writing a poem that says how we feel in a way that's authentic to us, it's always been the way we share our feelings."

articles.title: The best red carpet looks from the 2026 Venice Film Festival
articles.summary: The Venice Film Festival, which typically sees the glamour of Hollywood travel by boat to the island of Lido every September, has arrived. This year, the 10-day red carpet roll-out will host the likes of Robert Pattinson, George and Amal Clooney and Penélope Cruz.
articles.body: The Venice Film Festival, which typically sees Hollywood A-listers travel by boat to the little island of Lido every September, has arrived. This year, the 10-day red carpet event will host the likes of George and Amal Clooney, Penélope Cruz, Robert Pattinson and Patrick Schwarzenegger and more in their formal finest. Some films will be watched too. The festival has long been a glamorous affair, but it has recently become a major platform for fashion news, fueling the industry marketing machine: Last year, Julia Roberts lent Amanda Seyfried her Dario Vitale Versace suit, Ayo Edibiri made her Venice debut in a custom red strapless dress by Chanel that teased Matthieu Blazy’s new direction, and Greta Lee did the same for Jonathan Anderson’s Dior. The event has come to be seen as an early finger in the wind ahead of the Oscars. This year, the movies in the running for the Golden Lion prize are deep, dark and, politically charged. Danny Boyle’s “Ink” – an adaptation of the acclaimed play about the early years of Rupert Murdoch (Guy Pearce) and his acquisition of London tabloid paper “The Sun” – kicks off the festival on its opening night. Following will be Werner Herzog’s “Bucking Fastard,” with sisters Kate and Rooney Mara who fall in love with the same man (Orlando Bloom), and Florian Zeller’s “Bunker,” in which real-life partners Penélope Cruz and Javier Bardem play a couple whose marriage becomes strained after the husband agrees to build a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire. However, the lineup has already drawn criticism for its lack of female directors — this year just two films, May el-Toukhy’s “Woman Unknown” and Rachel Szor’s “NAZA,” directed by women are in the main competition for the grand prize. “There’s a systemic problem. It’s much harder for women to get their films financed,” said director Maggie Gyllenhaal, the jury president for this year’s festival. “Who decides what’s good and valuable?” Gyllenhaal is also screening a short Marilyn Monroe biopic starring Dakota Johnson and Ellen Burstyn, though it’s not competing. With just a handful of Hollywood stars set to grace the carpet, there’s reason to believe the fashion on show might skew considered and cerebral. But with musicians like Phoebe Bridgers as well as Liam and Noel Gallagher expected to make an appearance — the Gallagher brothers are rarely seen on a red carpet, let alone together — there’s still plenty to look forward to. Scroll down to see this year’s best and boldest looks

articles.title: Alanis Morissette sues ex-tour manager over alleged blackmail, false drug trafficking claims
articles.summary: Alanis Morissette claimed her former tour manager threatened to frame her for drug trafficking at a U.K. airport unless she agreed to a 15-year contract.
articles.body: Alanis Morissette claimed to be the victim of a "calculated blackmail campaign" allegedly orchestrated by her "disgruntled former tour manager," according to court documents obtained by Fox News Digital. The "Ironic" singer accused Keren Urinov of civil extortion in a lawsuit filed Tuesday, and claimed her ex-manager attempted to frame her for drug trafficking at an airport in the United Kingdom. "While temporarily employed to manage a Morissette tour, Urinov admitted to the British Border Force that a bag seized at an airport that allegedly contained marijuana and xylazine belonged to her," the documents stated. RAPPER FACES $2.8M LAWSUIT AFTER AXING OPENING ACT FROM TOUR FOLLOWING HER POLITICAL RANT "Urinov now threatens to report to the British authorities that Morissette committed drug trafficking unless Morissette agrees to employ her as a tour director for fifteen years and pay her massive compensation." The Canadian singer allegedly hired Urinov in 2025 to serve as her temporary tour manager. In July 2025, Morissette and her team were scheduled to fly from Farnborough Airport in the U.K. to Spain for a concert. "At the airport, a British Border Force official flagged a bag for further inspection and asked who owned the bag. Urinov said the bag was hers," the documents stated. Urinov allegedly told the team that the Border Force "had arrested her and issued her a seizure notice alleging that the bag contained marijuana and xylazine" after she admitted the bag belonged to her. "Urinov showed the Border Force her Israeli medical marijuana license. The Border Force returned the bag to Urinov and released her," the lawsuit stated. BLAKE LIVELY ALLEGES ‘MEAN GIRL’ SMEAR CAMPAIGN DAMAGED HER CAREER, SEEKS UP TO $296M The following day, the touring team flew back to the United Kingdom, and upon landing, Urinov was once again detained and re-affirmed ownership of the bag and the alleged drugs inside. "After the tour ended, Urinov and her attorney sent a series of increasingly extortionate letters to Morissette," documents stated. "Urinov threatened to file a patently frivolous lawsuit against Morissette in the United Kingdom for unspecified claims if Morissette refused to tell British law enforcement that the alleged drugs were hers." She continued, "However, Urinov communicated, Morissette could put ‘an end to the matter’ by entering into a fixed-term, full-time employment contract of fifteen years with Urinov, under which Urinov would receive an income equivalent to that of a tour director with annual increases and bonuses." "Morissette is not interested in employing Urinov for fifteen years—not only because she is a blackmailer, but also because she was a terrible manager of the 2025 tour," documents stated. The "You Oughta Know" singer claimed Urinov made an "inexplicable error" in hotel bookings that allegedly cost the singer $70,000. LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? articles.title: Jennifer Aniston’s boyfriend Jim Curtis opens up on partial paralysis, chronic nerve damage which makes him walk with a limp now: ‘You don't have to live as a victim'
articles.summary: Jennifer Aniston has been in a relationship with life coach and hypnotist Jim Curtis since 2025, and the couple has gradually become more open about t.
articles.body: Jennifer Aniston has been in a relationship with life coach and hypnotist Jim Curtis since 2025, and the couple has gradually become more open about their life together. Curtis, 50, is also an author and has recently released a book titled 'The Book of Possibility'. In a rare appearance with Aniston, he spoke candidly about a deeply personal chapter of his life, being diagnosed with lesions on his spinal cord in his 20s, a condition that resulted in chronic nerve damage and partial paralysis.Aniston, 57, and Curtis made a rare joint appearance at the 92nd Street Y in New York City on Wednesday, September 2, where they attended an event celebrating Curtis’ new book. During the conversation, Curtis reflected on how his health struggles changed the way he viewed himself, his body and his life.Curtis, who now walks with a limp, described the diagnosis as an ultimate low. Recalling the night he first learned about his condition, he said he had been experiencing severe pain and spent hours in a New York City emergency room.As quoted by People, “I found myself in the hospital one night because I was having such severe pain in my body, and in a New York City emergency room, I was there for 13 hours, and it was maybe 2:00 am. and the nurse came, and I said, ‘Is the doctor going to see me? What are you working me up for?’ And she said, ‘A diagnosis right there,’” Curtis recounted. “And it was a really scary diagnosis.”Curtis said that looking up the diagnosis on Google while still in the hospital made the situation even more frightening. He recalled feeling his body “freeze and seize up without the fear of what Google had to say about this.”Despite the fear, he eventually tried to shift his mindset and tell himself, “Tomorrow, everything changes.” Curtis explained that learning to approach his condition differently was not an overnight process and required years of personal growth.“I’m not saying here that the doctor tells you to do something you should get up and leave,” Curtis said. “What I’m saying is that you don’t have to live as the victim. You don’t have to live in your suffering.”He further explained that accepting one's struggles can eventually change the way they are experienced.Curtis said those struggles “can become your power as soon as you accept and love them”However, getting to that point of acceptance was difficult for him. Curtis admitted that he was once embarrassed about his medical condition and would give people a different explanation for his injury.“I would say I got into a motorcycle accident,” Curtis said. “I was so shameful that I had a medical condition. [I thought] I was broken in some way. I thought the motorcycle accident was at least a little macho.”Curtis said that he eventually managed to “overcome” those feelings through “self-acceptance and self-love”, although he believes the process could have been shorter.The discussion also turned towards life choices and finding one's purpose. Aniston, who rarely speaks publicly about her relationship with Curtis, asked him a question about helping someone who feels trapped in an unfulfilling life.“If someone said to you, ‘I’m at this crossroads, and I am stuck, and I’m in this rat race of a life, and I’m fully invested, but I know that’s not my calling. My soul, my heart is screaming to do something else’. How would you help coach someone through that?”Curtis explained that he does not advise people to abruptly abandon their existing responsibilities in pursuit of a dream.“I’m not a proponent of ‘drop everything and leave,’” he replied. “That [acceptance] was 25 years in the making for me.”“There’s a reality of life too. You have rent to pay and medical bills to pay and kids to feed, all of your stuff,” he continued. “But I will say this: you don’t have to let fear stop you from living your dream. You can manifest at any time by placing your focus on the outcomes that you want.”More about Jennifer Aniston and Jim Curtis’ RelationshipAniston and Curtis were first romantically linked in July 2025. Their relationship has since attracted considerable attention, although the two have largely kept their personal lives away from the spotlight.In May, Curtis shared several pictures featuring Aniston, including a kissing selfie, while PEOPLE subsequently confirmed that the couple had celebrated their first anniversary. Curtis has also spoken about becoming part of Aniston’s close-knit circle of friends. During an appearance on The Jamie Kern Lima Show on August 31, he discussed the strong bond Aniston shares with her longtime friends, including fellow Friends star Courteney Cox. He described the group as “like family” and added, “I feel incredibly blessed to be part [of] and welcomed into that family.”Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Richard Gere celebrates 77th birthday with wife Alejandra Silva, 43, and young son in rare family photos
articles.summary: Alejandra Silva posted rare photos of Richard Gere and their son James celebrating his 77th birthday as the family settles into life in Spain.
articles.body: Richard Gere rang in his 77th birthday with his 43-year-old wife, Alejandra Silva, and their six-year-old son. Silva took to Instagram on Tuesday to celebrate her husband's special day. "No one I rather spend my life with, happy birthday, I love you, we love you 🥰," she captioned her post, which included an image of the couple hugging. Also included in the post was a picture of their son, James Gere, joining in on the hug. Silva also shared an image of her sitting on a bench with their family pets. RICHARD GERE AND WIFE EYE US COMEBACK MONTHS AFTER MOVING TO SPAIN Gere and Silva reconnected romantically in 2014 after first meeting years earlier through family friends. They married in 2018 and share two sons, Alexander and James. The couple moved their family to Spain in 2024 to be closer to Silva’s roots. In 2025, Silva spoke to the Daily Mail about her family's plans now that they live in her home country. "For a few years [we’ll live in Spain], and then come back. But we're always coming back," she said, referring to her sons. "We'll come back here in the summer because we have the kids at camp. We just have to balance our lives there and here," she continued. After years of living in New York City with Gere, the couple decided to move to Spain, where Silva is originally from, and raise their children there. articles.body: It's the first Thursday in September. Love is in the air and to prove that, we have Trinity Rodman showing up at the US Open in a crop top supporting her tennis player boyfriend Ben Shelton. Australia's "Queen of Infomercials," 54, reveals why she only wants "no-strings-attached fun" with younger men Rozz Switzer, a former Australian TV presenter, actress, media entrepreneur, and sometimes referred to in her home country as the "Queen of Infomercials," is now a happy jaguar. She's at the top of the romantic food chain when it comes to older single women enjoying the company of young men. "I'm embracing what I call the Jaguar effect. The pumas are the girls in their 30s, the cougars are in their 40s but the 50s onward is the jaguars. As you know, jaguars are the pinnacle of the cat world, the apex predator!' she told the Daily Mail recently. Fascinating, am I right? Is all this cat talk how so many end up with a house full of cats? I'm no scientist, so I can't answer that. I know you’re on the edge of your seat, as am I, prepared for more feline love talk. Let's do that and leave the science to someone else to figure out. "Nothing is above them in the food chain. They are solitary by nature... they don't need anyone. Single and thriving. Rather than chasing, I let things come to me and I choose," Switzer continued. "Think of the car, they didn't call it a cougar, they called it a Jaguar because it is sleek and sophisticated." That's right, they do call it a Jaguar and not a cougar. And it is sleek and sophisticated. Cats and cars are what you want in a love life with no strings attached. "I got all the way to my 50s and now I am enjoying them! I am now so busy and I don't need a man in my life to give me the things I already have," she explained. "If I like the company I will have the company. It's the Jaguar effect, I get to pick and choose. It doesn't have to have any connection at all, it is all for fun and pleasure!" Well there you have it. A form of romance that on paper looks like it could be lonely and have a slight scent of cat food. That couldn’t be further from how it works when practiced in the real world. In reality, it's sleek and sophisticated, and you're the apex predator in a cat world. It's about fun and being drama free. I know that would appear to the untrained eye as if there are unresolved issues with relationships. That's silly. They're stocked up on protection, and it's a go on getting the dome rocking during this year's festival. Sure there's lost time to make up for, but not without throwing safety out the window. "We want an atmosphere where people are playing, and not walking around staring at people, or looking at people to pick up on. articles.title: Arrest warrant issued for ‘Below Deck Mediterranean’ star Nathan Gallagher
articles.summary: Australian police have issued an arrest warrant for “Below Deck Mediterranean” star Nathan Gallagher after he missed a court appearance related to an alleged domestic violence incident.
articles.body: Australian police have issued an arrest warrant for “Below Deck Mediterranean” star Nathan Gallagher after he missed a court appearance related to an alleged domestic violence incident. New South Wales police shared a photo of Gallagher, 28, and asked the public for help locating him. He is known to frequent the Emington and Melrose Park areas but is “believed to be offshore,” authorities said in a news release, which notes he has outstanding warrants in Sydney. In a Facebook post, police warned the public not to approach him if spotted. The reality star, from Burtonport, Ireland, works as a deckhand on the Bravo series. He was arrested on domestic violence charges in December 2025, NBC Los Angeles reported. Gallagher was granted conditional bail. He was due back in court Tuesday but never appeared, according to the station. In a statement to Rolling Stone in August, Gallagher acknowledged he has “made mistakes,” but said he didn’t think “the public has heard the full story surrounding what happened.” Police have not named the alleged victim, but Rolling Stone reported that Gallagher’s statement pointed to his former partner and “Below Deck” cast member Gael Cameron. He called the situation “extremely complicated.” “I’m not claiming I was perfect. I wasn’t. I made mistakes and I will take responsibility for my own actions. But I will not accept being portrayed solely through one person’s account of a relationship when there is another side and evidence relating to it,” he told Rolling Stone. Gallagher added his biggest concern was his son, whom he shares with Cameron. “Below Deck Mediterranean” is currently airing its 11th season. Bravo and Cameron did not immediately respond to a request for comment Thursday.

articles.title: Quiénes son los invitados de 'Pasapalabra' hoy
articles.standfirst: Cuatro nuevos famosos llegan al programa de Roberto Leal en Antena 3
articles.summary: Cuatro nuevos famosos llegan al programa de Roberto Leal en Antena 3
articles.body: Este jueves, 3 de septiembre, ‘Pasapalabra’ da la bienvenida a cuatro nuevos famosos que tratarán de ayudar a los concursantes para que sumen segundos de cara a la prueba final ‘AlaZ’. Cabe recordar que ‘El Rosco’ fue cancelado y adquirido por Telecinco por un litigio legal por sus derechos. De esta manera, Roberto Leal recibe en su programa a Berta Collado, Pepón Nieto, Blanca Romero y Álex Villazán. Berta Collado nació en Talavera de la Reina (Toledo) y tiene 47 años y es una de las presentadoras y actrices más conocidas de nuestro país. Presentó algunos programas como 'Do U Play?', 'Insert Coin’, ‘Involución', 'Telepasión' o 'Se acabó lo que se daba' o colaboraciones en espacios como 'Zapeando' o 'Todo es mentira'. Apareció en algunas series como ‘Gym Tony’ o ‘Museo Coconut’ y también presentó espacios radiofónicos como ‘Las mañanas Kiss’. Pepón Nieto, natal de Marbella (Málaga) y de 59 años, es un actor español conocido por aparecer en producciones como ‘Días contados’, ‘Mañana es hoy’, ‘Lo nunca visto’ ‘Furia’ o ‘Veneno’. Además, también estuvo en espacios como ‘Me resbala’, ‘Maestros de la costura’ o ‘Viva la vida’. Blanca Romero nació en Gijón y tiene 50 años, y es una de las actrices más contrastadas de España. Estuvo en series como 'Física o química' o 'Pura sangre', así como también presentó algunos espacios como 'Next Level Chef' o participó en 'El club de Flo' o 'Bailando con las estrellas'. Actualmente, se encuentra vinculada sentimentalmente con Quique Sánchez Flores, entrenador del Deportivo Alavés. Alex Villazán, natural de Madrid y de 33 años, es un reconocido actor español. Entre su filmografía destacan algunos títulos como 'Como la espuma', 'Mientras dure la guerra' o apariciones en series como 'El refugio atómico', 'Alma', 'Las hijas de la criada' o 'Todas las veces que nos enamoramos'. Ganó el premio a Mejor Actor Revelación por parte de la Unión de Actores y Actrices en 2019 por su interpretación en 'El curioso incidente del perro a medianoche'
